name: Graticule
description: Overlays a configurable lat/lon or local metric coordinate grid on the 2D map.

descriptionFull.title: Draws a graticule over the map that redraws on pan/zoom. Supports lat/lon spacing (auto or fixed degrees) or a local metric grid (every N km) about the map center using the mission's planetary radius, with edge labels, color and opacity controls.

components.name: Default Mode
components.description: Grid mode when the tool opens.

components.name: Default Line Color
components.description: Hex color of grid lines and labels (e.g. #ffffff).

author: NASA-AMMOS/MMGIS
